sentences.zh: 又翼日，皇帝御殿，賜後族及贐送後者，各有差。

translations.literal: On the next day, the emperor presides in the hall and bestows gifts upon the empress's clan and those who escorted the empress, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the next day the emperor presides in the hall and bestows gifts upon the empress's clan and those who escorted her, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 受賜者再拜，進酒，再拜。

translations.literal: Those who receive gifts perform a double bow, present wine, and perform a double bow again.
translations.idiomatic: Those who receive gifts bow twice, present wine, and bow twice again.

sentences.zh: 皇帝御別殿，有司進皇后服飾之籍。

translations.literal: The emperor presides in a separate hall; the relevant offices present the register of the empress's garments and ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor presides in a separate hall, and the relevant offices present the register of the empress's garments and ornaments.

sentences.zh: 酒五行，送後者辭訖，皇族獻後族禮物；

translations.literal: After five rounds of wine, the escorts take their leave; the imperial clan presents gifts to the empress's clan;
translations.idiomatic: After five rounds of wine the escorts take their leave; the imperial clan presents gifts to the empress's clan;

sentences.zh: 後族以禮物謝當奧者。

translations.literal: the empress's clan reciprocate with gifts to thank the one occupying the seat of honor.
translations.idiomatic: and the empress's clan reciprocate with gifts to thank the one occupying the seat of honor.

sentences.zh: 禮畢。

translations.literal: The ceremony is complete.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is complete.

sentences.zh: 公主下嫁儀：選公主諸父一人為婚主，凡當奧者、媒者致詞之儀，自納幣至禮成，大略如納後儀。

translations.literal: Ceremony for a princess marrying down: One of the princess's paternal uncles is chosen as master of the wedding; all ceremonies in which the one in the seat of honor or the matchmaker speaks—from betrothal gifts to completion—follow the ceremony for taking an empress in the main.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for a princess marrying down: one of the princess's paternal uncles is chosen as master of the wedding; all ceremonies in which the one in the seat of honor or the matchmaker speaks—from betrothal gifts to completion—follow the ceremony for taking an empress in the main.

sentences.zh: 擇吉日，詰旦，媒者趣尚主之家詣宮。

translations.literal: An auspicious day is chosen; at dawn, matchmakers hurry to the groom's household and proceed to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: An auspicious day is chosen; at dawn the matchmakers hurry to the groom's household and proceed to the palace.

sentences.zh: 俟皇帝、皇后禦便殿，率其族入見。

translations.literal: When the emperor and empress preside in the side hall, he leads his clan in to pay audience.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor and empress preside in the side hall, he leads his clan in to pay audience.

sentences.zh: 進酒訖，命皇族與尚主之族相偶飲。

translations.literal: When wine has been presented, the emperor orders the imperial clan and the groom's clan to drink in paired groups.
translations.idiomatic: When wine has been presented, the emperor orders the imperial clan and the groom's clan to drink in paired groups.

sentences.zh: 翼日，尚主之家以公主及婿率其族入見，致宴於皇帝、皇后。

translations.literal: On the following day, the groom's household brings the princess and son-in-law leading their clan to pay audience and hold a banquet for the emperor and empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day the groom's household brings the princess and her husband, leading their clan, to pay audience and hold a banquet for the emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 獻贐送者禮物訖，朝辭。

translations.literal: When gifts from those who escorted the bride have been presented, they take their leave at court.
translations.idiomatic: When gifts from those who escorted the bride have been presented, they take their leave at court.

sentences.zh: 賜公主青幰車二，螭頭、蓋部皆飾以銀，駕駝；

translations.literal: The princess is granted two green-canopied carriages, with dragon-head fittings and canopy frames all trimmed in silver, drawn by camels;
translations.idiomatic: The princess is granted two green-canopied carriages, with dragon-head fittings and canopy frames all trimmed in silver, drawn by camels;

sentences.zh: 送終車一，車樓純錦，銀螭，懸鐸，後垂大氈，駕牛，載羊一，謂之祭羊，擬送終之具，至履屍儀物咸在。

translations.literal: one funeral carriage, its frame draped in pure brocade with silver dragons, bells suspended, and a large felt hanging behind, drawn by oxen and carrying one sheep—the offering sheep—intended as funeral equipment; all objects for the corpse-dressing rite are included.
translations.idiomatic: and one funeral carriage, its frame draped in pure brocade with silver dragons, bells suspended, and a large felt hanging behind, drawn by oxen and carrying one sheep—the offering sheep—intended as funeral equipment; all objects for the corpse-dressing rite are included.

sentences.zh: 賜其婿朝服、四時襲衣、鞍馬，凡所須無不備。

translations.literal: Her son-in-law is granted court dress, seasonal robes for all four seasons, saddle and horse—everything needed is fully supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Her husband is granted court dress, seasonal robes for all four seasons, saddle and horse—everything he needs is fully supplied.

sentences.zh: 選皇族一人，送至其家。

translations.literal: One member of the imperial clan is chosen to escort them to the groom's home.
translations.idiomatic: One member of the imperial clan is chosen to escort them to the groom's home.

sentences.zh: 親王女封公主者婚儀：仿此，以親疏為差降。

translations.literal: Marriage ceremony for daughters of princes enfeoffed as princesses: This is modeled on the above, with gradations according to closeness of kinship.
translations.idiomatic: Marriage ceremony for daughters of princes enfeoffed as princesses: this follows the same pattern, with gradations according to closeness of kinship.
